name: Thai-Inspired Turkey Burgers with Napa Cabbage Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium head napa cabbage
2 medium carrots
1 jalapeño pepper
1 lime
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Place the ground turkey in a medium bowl.
Quarter the jalapeño pepper lengthwise; remove and discard the stem, seeds, and membranes. Finely dice the pepper and add to the turkey.

Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add ½ of the cilantro to the turkey mixture and the other ½ to a large salad bowl (that will be used for the slaw).
Juice the lime; pour ½ into the bowl with the turkey mixture and the other ½ into the salad bowl.
Peel and grate or mince the ginger; add to the turkey mixture.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
While the pan / skillet heats up, add coconut aminos to the turkey mixture and mix the ingredients until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 2 patties.
Once the pan / skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the patties in the pan / skillet; cook until they are cooked through and browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the patties to a plate.
Add coconut aminos, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and honey to the salad bowl; whisk the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
coconut aminos
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
1 tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise and add to the salad bowl.

Peel the carrots, then trim off the ends; discard the peels and trimmings. Using a box grater, coarsely grate the carrots and add to the salad bowl. Toss the salad until well coated with the dressing.
To serve, place the bottom half of a bun on a plate, top with a patty and some of the slaw, and close with the top half of the bun. Serve with the remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!
